title: First Mid’s Workplace Culture Continues to Earn National Recognition
summary: Mattoon, IL (August 3, 2026) At First Mid, creating a great workplace has always been about fostering an environment where employees can build rewarding careers, support one another, and make a meaningful impact. This year, that approach has once again earned national recognition. First Mid has received its fourth consecutive Top Workplaces Financial Services Industry award, along with seven Top Workplaces Culture Excellence awards recognizing its strengths in Compensation Benefits, Employee Appreciation, Employee Well-Being, Innovation, Professional Development, Purpose Values, and Work-Life Flexibility. Together, these awards reflect a workplace defined by trust, collaboration, and the everyday contributions of employees. One of First Mids greatest strengths has always been our people," said Matt Smith, Chief Executive Officer and President at First Mid.
